1: Barkat wala hai woh Allah jis ne apne bande aur Rasool Muhammad ﷺ par Quran utara, jo haqq aur baatil mein farq karne wala meyaar hai, taake woh insaano aur jinnon ke liye Rasool hon aur unhein Allah ke azaab se daraane wale.
2: Wohi jis ke liye akele aasmaano aur zameen ki baadshahat hai, jis ne koi aulaad nahin banayi, aur na Us ki baadshahat mein Us ka koi sharik hai, jis ne har cheez munasib taur par paida ki aur apne ilm aur apni hikmat ke mutabiq us ki paidaish ka poora andaza rakha.
3: Aur mushrikon ne Allah ke siwa aise maabood bana liye jo kisi chhoti ya bari cheez ko paida nahin kar sakte, balke khud banaye gaye hain. Be-shak Allah ne unhein adam se paida kiya; woh na apne se koi nuqsan hata sakte hain aur na apne liye koi faida laa sakte hain, aur na kisi zinda ko maut de sakte hain aur na kisi murda ko zindagi, aur na murdon ko un ki qabron se utha sakte hain.
4: Aur jin logon ne Allah aur Us ke Rasool ka inkaar kiya unhon ne kaha: 'Yeh Quran ek jhoot ke siwa kuch nahin jo Muhammad ﷺ ne ghad liya aur Allah ki taraf mansoob kar diya. Aur doosre logon ne bhi is ko ghadne mein un ki madad ki.' Khud in kafiron ne ek jhooti baat kahi, kyunke Quran Allah ka kalaam hai; insaano aur jinnon ke liye na-mumkin hai ke woh is jaisa kuch laa sakein.
5: Aur Quran ke in jhutlane walon ne kaha: 'Quran pichle logon ke be-kaar qisse hain jo woh likh liya karte the; Muhammad ﷺ ne unhein naql kar liya. Woh din bhar un par padhe jate hain.'
6: Aey Rasool, in jhutlane walon se keh dijiye: Quran us Allah ne utara jo aasmaano aur zameen ki har cheez ko jaanta hai. Woh ghada hua nahin jaisa tum samajhte ho. Be-shak Allah apne un bandon ke liye Bakhshne wala hai jo tauba karte hain, aur un par Meharban hai.
7: Aur un mushrikon ne, jinhon ne Nabi ﷺ ko jhutlaya, kaha: 'Is shaks ko kya hua jo daawa karta hai ke woh Allah ka bheja hua rasool hai, jab ke woh doosre logon ki tarah khana khata hai aur rozi ki talash mein bazaron mein chalta phirta hai? Allah ne us ke saath koi farishta kyun nahin bheja jo us ke saath rehta, us ki sachhaai ka elaan karta aur us ki madad karta?'
8: 'Ya us ke liye aasman se koi khazana kyun nahin utaar diya gaya, ya us ka koi baagh kyun nahin jis ke phal woh khata, taake use rozi ki talash mein bazaron mein chalna na pade?' Aur zaalimon ne yeh bhi kaha: 'Aey momino, tum kisi rasool ke peeche nahin chal rahe; tum to bas ek aise aadmi ke peeche chal rahe ho jis ki aql par jaadu ghalib aa chuka hai.'
9: Aey Rasool, dekhiye aur taajjub kijiye ke woh aap ko kaisi jhooti sifaton se bayan karte hain, yani unhon ne kaha: 'Woh jaadugar hain', 'Un par jaadu kiya gaya hai' aur 'Woh deewane hain'; aur is wajah se woh haqq se hat gaye. Woh hidayat ke raaste par chalne aur aap ki sachhaai aur aap ki amanat-daari par sawal uthane se aajiz hain.
10: Barkat wala hai woh Allah jo, agar chahe, aap ko woh bhalai de sakta hai jo woh aap ke liye sochte hain: aise baagh jin ke darakhton ke neeche nahrein behti hain aur jin ke phal aap kha sakein; aur aap ko aise mahal bhi de sakta hai jin mein aap aish se rahein.
11: Un ki yeh baatein haqq ya daleel ki talash mein nahin kahi gayin, balke asal baat yeh hai ke unhon ne Qayamat ke din ko jhutla diya. Aur jo Qayamat ke din ko jhutlaye, us ke liye Maine ek bhadakti hui aag tayyar kar rakhi hai.
12: Jab kafir Jahannam ki aag ko door se dekhenge, to woh us se ek bechain kar dene wali, sakht khaulne ki aawaz sunenge, un par us ke gusse ki wajah se.
13: Aur jab in kafiron ko ek tang jagah se Jahannam mein daala jayega, un ke haath un ki gardanon se bandhe hue, to woh apne liye halakat pukarenge, is umeed par ke Jahannam se nikal jayein.
14: Aey kafiro, aaj apne liye ek tarah ki halakat mat pukaro; bahut si qismein pukaro! Is se koi farq nahin padega; tum jo maangte ho woh tumhein nahin milega. Balke tum hamesha dardnaak azaab mein rahoge.
15: Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: 'Kya yeh azaab, jis ka zikr tumhare liye hua, behtar hai, ya woh hamesha rehne wali Jannat apni un naimaton ke saath jo kabhi khatam nahin hotin? Yeh wahi hai jis ka Allah ne apne un bandon se wada kiya jo Us se darte hain, un ke ajr aur us ghar ke taur par jis ki taraf woh Qayamat ke din lautenge.'
16: Is Jannat mein unhein har woh naimat milegi jis ki woh chaahat karenge; yeh Allah par ek wada hai jise Us ke Allah se darne wale bande Us se maangenge. Aur Allah ka wada poora ho kar rahega, kyunke Woh kabhi wade nahin todta.
17: Aur jis din jhutlane wale mushrik jama kiye jayenge, un ke saath woh bhi jin ki woh Allah ke siwa ibadat karte the, to Woh un pooje jaane walon se kahega, un ke poojne walon ko daantte hue: 'Kya tum ne Mere bandon ko gumraah kiya, unhein apni ibadat ka hukm de kar, ya woh apne aap hi bhatak gaye?'
18: Woh pooje jaane wale kahenge: 'Aey hamare Rubb, tu is se buland hai ke tera koi sharik ho. Hamare liye yeh zaib nahin tha ke hum tujhe chhod kar koi kaar-saaz banayein, phir hum tere bandon ko yeh kaise kehte ke tujhe chhod kar hamari ibadat karein? Aey hamare Rubb, balke tu ne in mushrikon aur in ke bade-buzurgon ko duniya ke mazon se faida uthane diya, unhein dheere dheere un ki halakat ki taraf kheenchte hue, yahan tak ke woh teri yaad bhool gaye aur tere saath doosron ki ibadat karne lage. Woh apni bad-naseebi ki wajah se barbaad hone wale log the.'
19: Aey mushriko, be-shak jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte the unhon ne tumhare un daawon ko jhutla diya jo tum un ke baare mein karte the, lihaza tum na apne se azaab hata sakte ho aur na apni be-bassi ki wajah se un ki madad kar sakte ho. Aur aey mominon, tum mein se jo shaks Allah ke saath sharik thehra kar zulm kare, Main use bada azaab chakhaoonga, jaise Main in logon ko chakhaoonga jin ka zikr hua.
20: Aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle jo rasool bheje woh sab insaan the jo khana khate the aur bazaron mein chalte the; aap is lihaz se koi anokhe rasool nahin. Aur aey logo, Maine tumhein ek doosre ke liye aazmaish banaya, tumhein alag alag darjon mein maal, tangi, sehat aur beemari de kar; in mukhtalif haalat mein, kya tum us par sabr karoge jis se Main tumhein aazmata hoon taake Main tumhein tumhare sabr ka ajr doon? Aur aap ka Rubb un logon se khoob khabardar hai jo sabr karte hain aur jo nahin karte, aur un se bhi jo Us ki itaat karte hain aur jo Us ki nafarmani karte hain.
21: Aur jo kafir Mujh se milne ki tawaqqo nahin rakhte aur Mere azaab se nahin darte, unhon ne kaha: 'Allah hamari taraf farishte kyun nahin bhejta, taake woh humein Muhammad ﷺ ki sachhaai ke baare mein batayein? Ya hum apne Rubb ko apni aankhon se kyun nahin dekh sakte, taake Woh humein is ke baare mein bataye?' Woh apne dilon mein bahut gurur karte hain aur isi ne unhein iman se roka, aur woh apni is baat se kufr aur sarkashi ki hadd se bahut aage barh gaye.
22: Jis din yeh log farishton ko dekhenge, apni maut ke waqt, barzakh mein, jab woh dobara zinda kiye jayenge, jab unhein hisaab ke liye haanka jayega aur jab unhein Aag mein daala jayega, to in tamam mauqon par un ke liye koi khush-khabri nahin hogi, mominon ke bar-aks, aur farishte un se kahenge: 'Allah ki taraf se khush-khabri tum par haraam aur mana hai.'
23: Aur Main un neik kaamon ki taraf rujoo karoonga jo kafiron ne duniya mein kiye, aur un ke kufr ki wajah se un ke be-kaar aur be-faida hone ki wajah se Main unhein us dhool ke zarron ki tarah bikhair doonga jo aadmi roshan-daan mein dekhta hai.
24: Aur us din momin, yani Jannat wale, in kafiron se behtar jagah aur behtar aaram aur neend ki jagah mein honge. Yeh un ke Allah par iman aur un ke neik aamaal ki wajah se hoga.
25: Aey Rasool, woh din yaad kijiye jab aasman phat kar barik safed baadal zaahir kar dega, aur farishte hashr ke maidan ki taraf kasrat se utaare jayenge, un ki bari tadaad ki wajah se.
26: Qayamat ke din baadshahat, jo sachchi aur pakki baadshahat hai, sirf Rehman ki hogi, paak hai Woh. Aur woh din kafiron ke liye mushkil hoga, mominon ke bar-aks jin ke liye woh aasan hoga.
27: Aey Rasool, woh din yaad kijiye jab zulm karne wala, Rasool ﷺ ki pairvi chhod dene par, pachhtawe mein apna haath kaatega aur kahega: 'Kaash maine Rasool ki aur us baat ki pairvi ki hoti jo woh apne Rubb ki taraf se laaye, aur maine un ke saath nijaat ka raasta apnaya hota.'
28: Aur woh shadeed gam mein apne aap par laanat karte hue yeh bhi kahega: 'Haaye meri barbaadi! Kaash maine falan kafir ko apna dost na banaya hota!'
29: 'Is kafir dost ne mujhe Quran se hata diya is ke baad ke woh Rasool ke zariye mujh tak pahunch gaya tha.' Aur shaytan hamesha se insaan ko dhoka dene wala raha hai. Jab us par koi mushkil aati hai to woh us se bezaari kar leta hai.
30: Aur Rasool us din apni qaum ke haal ki shikayat karte hue kahenge: 'Aey mere Rubb, meri qaum ne, jis ki taraf tu ne mujhe bheja, is Quran ko chhod diya aur use nazar-andaaz kar diya.'
31: Aey Rasool, jis tarah ki takleef aur jis tarah ka aap ke raaste se rokna aap ko apni qaum se pesh aaya, usi tarah Maine aap se pehle har nabi ke liye us ki qaum ke bure logon mein se ek dushman muqarrar kiya tha. Aur aap ka Rubb rehnuma ke taur par kaafi hai jo haqq ki hidayat deta hai, aur madadgaar ke taur par bhi kaafi hai jo aap ke dushman ke khilaaf aap ki madad karega.
32: Aur jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya unhon ne kaha: 'Quran us par ek hi baar mein kyun nahin utara gaya, tukdon tukdon mein kyun?' Maine Quran thoda thoda karke is liye utara ke aap ka dil, aey Rasool, us ke baar baar utarne se mazboot ho. Aur Maine use aap par thoda thoda karke is liye utara ke aap ke liye use samajhna aur yaad karna aasan ho.
33: Aur aey Rasool, mushrik aap ke paas koi aisi baat nahin laate jise woh pesh karein magar yeh ke Main aap ke paas us ka sachcha aur pakka jawab laa doon aur aap ke paas woh cheez laa doon jo zyada achhi tarah wazeh hai.
34: Woh log jinhein Qayamat ke din apne chehron ke bal ghaseet kar Jahannam ki taraf le jaya jayega: aise log sab se buri jagah mein hain kyunke un ka thikana Jahannam hoga, aur woh sab se bure raaste par hain kyunke un ka raasta kufr aur bhatakne ka raasta hai.
35: Aur Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko Taurat di aur un ke bhai Haroon (alaihis salaam) ko un ki madad ke liye rasool banaya.
36: Chunanche Maine un dono se kaha: Firaun aur us ki qaum ke paas jao jinhon ne Meri nishaniyan jhutlayin. Chunanche unhon ne Hamara hukm poora kiya aur un ke paas gaye aur unhein Allah ke yakta hone ki taraf bulaya, magar unhon ne un dono ko jhutlaya aur phir Maine unhein un ke jhutlane ki wajah se poori tarah halak kar diya.
37: Aur Nooh ki qaum ko bhi: jab unhon ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko jhutla kar tamam rasoolon ko jhutla diya, to Maine unhein samundar mein dubo kar halak kar diya, aur Maine un ki halakat ko zaalimon ko mitane ki apni qudrat ki nishani banaya. Aur Maine zaalimon ke liye Qayamat ke din dardnaak azaab tayyar kar rakha hai.
38: Aur Maine Aad ko bhi halak kiya, jo Hud (alaihis salaam) ki qaum thi, aur Samood ko bhi, jo Saleh (alaihis salaam) ki qaum thi. Aur Maine Ashab-e-Rass ko halak kiya aur in teenon ke darmiyan bahut si ummatein bhi halak kein.
39: Aur in halak kiye jaane walon mein se har ek ke liye Maine pichli ummaton ki halakat aur us ki wajhein bayan ki theen taake woh sabaq lein, aur un mein se har ek ko Maine poori tarah halak kar diya, un ke kufr aur un ki hath-dharmi ki wajah se.
40: Aur aap ki qaum ke yeh jhutlane wale, Shaam ke apne safar mein, Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ki us basti ke paas se guzre hain jis par un ki be-haayi ki saza mein paththar barsaye gaye the, taake woh sabaq lein. Kya woh is basti se andhe the aur unhon ne use dekha nahin? Nahin! Balke woh dobara uthaye jaane aur us ke baad hisaab ki tawaqqo hi nahin rakhte.
41: Aur aey Rasool, jab bhi yeh jhutlane wale aap se milte hain to woh aap ka mazaaq udate hain aur mazaaq aur inkaar ke taur par kehte hain: 'Kya yahi woh shaks hai jise Allah ne hamari taraf rasool bana kar bheja?'
42: 'Qareeb tha ke yeh humein hamare maaboodon ki ibadat se hata deta. Agar hum un ki ibadat par itni mazbooti se jame na hote to yeh apni dalilon aur apne subooton se humein us se hata deta.' Woh jald jaan lenge, jab woh apni qabron mein aur Qayamat ke din azaab dekhenge, ke raaste se sab se door kaun hai, yeh ya woh; aur unhein maaloom ho jayega ke in mein se gumraah kaun hai.
43: Aey Rasool, kya aap ne us shaks ko dekha jis ne apni khwahish ko apna maabood bana liya aur us ke peeche chal pada? Kya aap us par nigehban banenge ke use iman ki taraf lauta laayein aur use kufr se roken?
44: Balke aey Rasool, kya aap samajhte hain ke un mein se aksar, jinhein aap Allah ke yakta hone aur Us ki itaat ki taraf bulate hain, maan kar sunte hain ya dalilein aur suboot samajhte hain? Woh apne sunne, apni samajh aur apne shuoor mein maweshiyon hi jaise hain. Balke woh maweshiyon se bhi zyada raaste se door hain.
45: Aey Rasool, kya aap ne nahin dekha ke aap ka Rubb zameen ki satah par saya kaise phailata hai? Agar Woh chahta ke use bina harkat ke thehra rakhe to kar sakta tha. Phir Maine sooraj ko us ki nishani banaya, ke woh us ke mutabiq lamba aur chhota hota hai.
46: Phir Maine us saye ko apni taraf kheench liya, use dheere dheere thoda thoda ghata kar, sooraj ki oonchaai ke mutabiq.
47: Aur Allah hi hai jis ne raat ko ek libas ki tarah banaya jo tumhein aur har cheez ko dhaap leti hai. Aur Wohi hai jis ne neend ko aaram banaya jis se tum apne kaam se aaram paate ho. Aur Wohi hai jis ne din ko woh waqt banaya jis mein tum apne kaam par nikalte ho.
48: Aur Wohi hai jis ne hawaein us baarish ke girne ki khush-khabri bana kar bheji jo Us ki apne bandon par rehmat hai. Aur Maine aasman se aisa baarish ka paani utara jo paak hai, jis se woh apne aap ko paak karte hain.
49: Taake Main us utarne wale paani se ek aisi banjar zameen ko zinda kar doon jis par koi sabza nahin, tarah tarah ke podey ugaa kar aur us par hariyali phaila kar, aur taake Main woh paani un bahut se jaanwaron aur un logon ko pilaoon jinhein Maine paida kiya.
50: Aur Maine Quran mein tarah tarah se dalilein aur suboot khol kar bayan kiye taake woh nasihat lein, magar aksar log apne jhutlane aur haqq ke inkaar par ade rehte hain.
51: Aur agar Meri marzi hoti to Main har basti mein ek rasool bhej deta jo unhein Allah ke azaab se daraata. Magar Maine aisa nahin chaaha. Maine sirf Muhammad ﷺ ko tamam logon ke liye rasool bana kar bheja.
52: Lihaza kafiron ki un maangon mein un ki baat na maaniye ke aap un se narmi barteen, aur un tajwizon mein bhi jo woh pesh karte hain. Aur is Quran ke zariye, jo aap par utara gaya, un se bada jihad kijiye: un ki takleef par sabr karke aur unhein Allah ki taraf bulane mein mushkilein bardaasht karke.
53: Aur Allah hi hai, paak hai Woh, jis ne behte hue do paaniyon ko aapas mein milaya. Us ne meetha aur khaara mila diya, aur un ke darmiyan ek aad aur ek rukawat rakh di jo unhein aapas mein ghulne se rokti hai.
54: Aur Wohi hai jis ne insaan ko mard aur aurat ke paani se paida kiya. Aur insaan ko paida karke Us ne khoon ka rishta aur nikah ka rishta qayam kiya. Aur aap ka Rubb har cheez par qaadir hai aur koi cheez Us ki qudrat se bahar nahin. Aur isi qudrat se Us ne insaan ko mard aur aurat ke paani se paida kiya.
55: Phir bhi kafir Allah ko chhod kar aise buton ki ibadat karte hain jo na unhein faida de sakte hain agar woh un ki baat maanein, aur na nuqsan pahuncha sakte hain agar woh un ke khilaaf jayein. Aur kafir hamesha se shaytan ke peeche us baat mein chalta raha hai jo Allah ko naraaz karti hai, paak hai Woh.
56: Aey Rasool, Maine aap ko sirf is liye bheja ke aap un logon ko khush-khabri dein jo iman la kar aur neik kaam karke Allah ki itaat karte hain, aur un logon ko daraayein jo kufr aur gunah karke Us ke khilaaf jate hain.
57: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: main paigham pahunchane par tum se koi ajr nahin maangta. Magar tum mein se jo shaks kharch karke Allah ki razamandi ka raasta apnana chahe, woh apna le.
58: Aur aey Rasool, apne tamam kaamon mein us Allah par bharosa rakhiye jo Zinda hai aur hamesha baaqi rehne wala hai aur jo kabhi nahin marta, aur Us ki paaki aur Us ki taarif bayan kijiye, paak hai Woh. Woh apne bandon ke gunahon ko khoob jaanta hai. Un mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin aur Woh unhein un ka badla dega.
59: Wohi jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko aur jo kuch un ke darmiyan hai chheh dinon mein paida kiya, phir Arsh par qayam hua, aise maani mein jo Us ki azmat ke laayak hai. Wohi Rehman hai, lihaza aey Rasool, Us ke baare mein us se poochiye jo khoob khabardar hai, aur woh Allah hai: Wohi jo har cheez jaanta hai aur jis se kuch chhipa nahin.
60: Aur jab kafiron se kaha jata hai: Rehman ko sajda karo, to woh kehte hain: hum Rehman ko sajda nahin karenge. Rehman kya hai? Hum Use nahin jaante aur na maante. Kya hum us ko sajda karein jise tum hum se kaho, jab ke hum Use jaante hi nahin? Aur unhein Use sajda karne ka hukm dena unhein Allah par iman se aur door hi kar deta hai.
61: Barkat wala hai Woh jis ne aasmaan mein sitaron aur chalne wale sitaron ke liye manzilein banayin, jis ne aasman mein ek aisa sooraj banaya jo roshni deta hai, aur jis ne ek aisa chaand banaya jo zameen ko sooraj ki us roshni se roshan karta hai jo us se palat kar aati hai.
62: Aur Allah hi hai jis ne raat aur din ko ek doosre ke peeche aur ek doosre ki jagah lene wala banaya, har us shaks ke liye jo Allah ki nishaniyon se sabaq lena aur seedhe raaste par aana chahe, ya Allah ki naimaton par Us ka shukr ada karna chahe.
63: Aur Rehman ke bande woh momin hain jo zameen par aajizi aur waqaar ke saath chalte hain, aur jab be-waqoof un se baat karte hain to woh usi andaaz mein jawab nahin dete balke unhein aisi baat kehte hain jo unhein un ki burai se bachaye.
64: Aur woh log jo raat apne Rubb ke liye sajde mein apne chehron ke bal aur apne paon par khade ho kar, dua karte hue guzarte hain.
65: Aur woh log jo apne Rubb se dua mein kehte hain: aey hamare Rubb, hum se Jahannam ka azaab hata de, kyunke Jahannam ka azaab un logon ke liye lagatar aur hamesha rehne wala hai jo kafir mar jate hain.
66: Woh kisi ke liye bhi rehne ki buri jagah hai aur kisi ke liye bhi basne ki buri jagah.
67: Aur woh log jo jab apna maal kharch karte hain to apne kharch mein fizool-kharchi ki hadd tak nahin jate, aur na apna kharch sirf un logon tak mehdood karte hain jin par kharch karna laazim hai, jaise apne aap par aur doosron par, balke un ka kharch fizool-kharchi aur kanjoosi ke darmiyan mo'tadil hota hai.
68: Aur woh log jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur maabood ko nahin pukarte, paak hai Woh, aur na kisi aisi jaan ko qatl karte hain jis ka qatl Allah ne haraam kiya, siwaye us ke jo Allah ne jaiz rakha, jaise qaatil, murtad ya shaadi-shuda zina karne wale ka qatl, aur na zina karte hain. Aur jo shaks yeh bade gunah kare use Qayamat ke din apne kiye gunah ki saza milegi.
69: Qayamat ke din us ka azaab dugna kar diya jayega, aur woh us azaab mein zaleel aur ruswa ho kar hamesha rahega.
70: Magar jo log Allah ki taraf tauba karein aur aise neik kaam karein jo un ki tauba ke khulus ki nishani hon, to Allah aise logon ke bure aamaal ko neik aamaal se badal dega. Allah apne un bandon ke gunah bakshne wala hai jo tauba karte hain, aur un par Meharban hai.
71: Aur jo log Allah ki taraf tauba karte hain aur neik kaam karke aur gunah chhod kar apni tauba ka khulus saabit karte hain, un ki tauba aisi tauba hai jo qabool ki jati hai.
72: Aur woh log jo jhoot mein shaamil nahin hote, jaise gunah aur haraam dil-lagi ki majlisein, aur jab woh be-kaar baaton aur be-kaar kaamon ke paas se guzarte hain to tezi se guzar jate hain, apni jaan ka waqaar rakhte hue aur in cheezon mein padne se bachte hue.
73: Aur woh log jo jab unhein Allah ki un nishaniyon ki yaad dilayi jati hai jo suni aur dekhi jati hain, to na suni jaane wali nishaniyon se kaan band karte hain aur na dekhi jaane wali nishaniyon se aankhein.
74: Aur woh log jo apne Rubb se dua mein kehte hain: aey hamare Rubb, humein hamari biwiyon aur hamari aulaad mein se woh de jo hamari aankhon ki thandak hon, apni parhezgaari aur haqq par apni sabit-qadmi ki wajah se. Aur humein haqq mein aise imam bana de jin ki pairvi woh log karein jo tujh se darte hain.
75: Jin logon mein yeh sifaat hain unhein Jannat ke sab se buland darje mein buland balakhane ata kiye jayenge, un ki Allah ki itaat par sabit-qadmi ke badle. Wahan farishte unhein salaam aur aman ke saath milenge aur woh wahan har mushkil se mehfooz honge.
76: Woh us mein hamesha rahenge: un ke liye basne ki khoobsurat jagah aur rehne ki achhi jagah.
77: Aey Rasool, un kafiron se keh dijiye jo apne kufr par ade hain: mera Rubb tumhari kabhi parwah nahin karega kisi aise faide ki wajah se jo Use tumhari itaat se mile. Agar yeh baat na hoti ke Woh tumhein tumhare apne faide ke liye bulata hai, to Woh tumhari koi parwah na karta. Ab jab tum ne us baat ko jhutla diya jo rasool tumhare Rubb ki taraf se laaye, to is jhutlane ka badla tum se juda nahin hoga.
